# Variegated.rs Instructions

See [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) in the repository root.

That file is the single source of truth for this repository's architecture, build commands,
and conventions. This file used to carry its own copy, which drifted: it went on describing
a flat crate layout, a package named `examples`, and no ESP32-C6 comms firmware, long after
none of that was true. A second copy is a second thing to forget to update, so there isn't
one any more.
